mapSource: Geofabrik Georgia country extract, with OpenStreetMap France mirror as build-time fallback
notes: The binary map is generated by GitHub Actions from a verified Georgia-country OpenStreetMap PBF. Geofabrik is primary; the OpenStreetMap France mirror is the build-time fallback. The map is checked against the provider MD5, written with Mapsforge Map Writer type=hd, then packaged inside the APK. The source ZIP does not contain generated binary map assets. Name variants are included only where available in OSM; no automatic translation is performed. The app independently enables English, Russian and Georgian map-label readers and combines enabled variants through Mapsforge MultiMapDataStore; visual label-collision and performance validation on physical devices remains pending. Map Writer receives explicit bbox=41.00,39.95,43.65,46.80 because the CI PBF mirror did not expose a usable bbox in its header. POI SQLite is generated from the exact same verified PBF and includes named nodes, closed ways and multipolygon relations. Relation extraction and same-name/same-category cross-geometry deduplication are implemented; the fresh full-country rebuild and search-relevance audit remain pending. Search indexes public address, phone, website, opening_hours, cuisine, wheelchair, internet_access, operator and brand tags when present; these are source values and are not treated as real-time opening or availability status. The optional road graph includes car, motorcycle, 4x4, bicycle and foot access profiles. Copernicus GLO-90 elevation tiles and their manifest are packaged in the APK; absent public cells are explicitly recorded and are not treated as zero elevation. A local eight-item pre-ride safety checklist is stored only in private app preferences and does not require network access. SRTM3-compatible 1201x1201 HGT ZIP tiles derived from the same Copernicus GLO-90 cells are packaged for offline Mapsforge hillshading; the app installs them into private storage on demand. A separate Mapsforge contour map is generated from the same Copernicus GLO-90 DEM tiles, cached and checksum-verified in CI, and rendered as an offline overlay for Oflayn Natural styles. The contour map is generated as a separate Mapsforge file from GLO-90 elevation contours (100 m minor, 500 m major), verified by SHA-256, and rendered only with Oflayn Natural map styles. It requires no runtime network access. POI extraction includes nodes, closed ways and multipolygon relations; same-name/same-category node-way-relation duplicates within 18 m are merged with relation geometry preferred and multilingual/contact tags preserved. The road graph v2 stores signed forward/backward incline and applies profile-specific uphill/downhill costs from OSM incline tags.
languageCoverage: Only OSM name variants present in source data are written; no automatic translation.
mapBuildPipeline: GitHub Actions: verified country OSM PBF -> Mapsforge map + relation-aware deduplicated POI database + optional road graph v2 with directional incline -> Copernicus GLO-90 DEM/HGT/contour map -> APK assets

poiDatabase.search: Local substring search across default, English, Russian and Georgian names when present, categories, subcategories, addresses and selected public contact/business tags; route-corridor search is available along a planned route; no network required.
poiDatabase.geometryCoverage: OSM nodes, closed ways and multipolygon relations; same-name/same-category cross-geometry duplicates within 18 m are merged, preferring relation geometry; fresh full-country coverage validation remains pending.
poiDatabase.nameCoverage: Only name variants present in OSM are stored; missing variants are not automatically translated.
poiDatabase.source: Same verified country OSM PBF as the Mapsforge map.
poiDatabase.deduplication: Same-name, same-category node/way/relation records within 18 m are merged; relation geometry is preferred and multilingual names/contact tags are combined.

poiSearchCapabilities: route-corridor POI search ordered along the planned route
